sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Archer:
Physical and magic Ability Power increases by M - 4XL+ based on the time elemental attack value.

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Archer.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate against Star enemies increases to L.
